chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Khazzaz, and Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Muthanna Al-Hannat, from Zurarah ibn A'yan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked: A woman left behind her mother, and her full siblings (from father and mother), and her paternal siblings (from father only), and her maternal siblings (from mother only). He said: 'For her paternal and maternal sisters (full sisters), two-thirds; and for her mother, one-sixth; and for her maternal brothers and sisters, one-sixth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of full sisters and maternal siblings when a woman dies leaving her mother?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), this hadith clarifies the specific shares for full sisters, the mother, and maternal siblings in a complex inheritance scenario. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that full siblings (from both parents) exclude maternal siblings from inheriting when a parent is present, while the mother’s share is reduced to one-sixth due to the presence of descendants or ascendants. This ruling underscores the precision of the Ahl al-Bayt’s interpretation of Quranic inheritance laws in resolving overlapping claims.
